cards.title: Keep the old sign-in endpoint for one more release?
cards.recommendation: Keep it one more release and mark it as going away. Two callers still use it.
cards.risk: Removing it now breaks both callers on the day of the release.
cards.cost: Half a day to keep it working beside the new one.
cards.why: The new endpoint is ready, but nobody has told the two callers yet.

cards.title: The nightly build has failed three nights running
cards.recommendation: Pin the test browser to last week's version until the new one is looked at.
cards.risk: Nothing merged since Tuesday has been tested end to end.
cards.cost: Ten minutes to pin; the real fix is not known yet.
cards.why: The test browser updated itself on Tuesday and two page tests now time out.

cards.title: Should the install guide name the download by its version?
cards.recommendation: Name it, and link to the latest release page as well.
cards.risk: A version in the guide goes stale with each release.
cards.cost: A line to change at each release.
cards.why: Two people asked which file to download.

cards.title: Move the settings page to the new form library?
cards.recommendation: Not yet. Wait until its two open bugs about dates are fixed.
cards.risk: Date fields would round to the wrong day in some time zones.
cards.cost: About two days, once the bugs are fixed.
cards.why: The old library is no longer maintained.

cards.title: Approve the database change waiting in the staging console
cards.recommendation: It adds one column and removes nothing.
cards.why: Only an owner of the staging account can approve it.

cards.title: Renew the code-signing certificate before it runs out on 3 December
cards.risk: Builds after that date cannot be signed.
cards.why: The certificate is in your name.

cards.title: The API's tests now run in 4 minutes, down from 11.
cards.why: The slow tests now share one test database.

cards.title: The colour settings moved to their own file. Nothing else changed.
cards.why: So the docs site can use the same colours.
